reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is automating approval decisions for selected harmless commands and operations targeting configured trusted areas, while deferring other requests to the user.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可配置的自动审批权限层，自动批准符合规则的命令及可信区域内的文件操作，并将其他请求交由用户处理。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable auto-approval permission tier to DeepSeek Harness that approves eligible commands and file operations in trusted areas while deferring other requests to the user.

capabilities: Automatically approves filesystem writes and edits within configured trusted areas
Adds and switches a permission preset for DeepSeek Harness sessions
Provides a configuration HTTP API for plugin settings
Records auto-approval decisions in the session log
